title: Operator voice services over IoT devices: demonstrating VoLTE calls over Cat-M1 networks
summary: Cat-M1 (LTE Category M1 technology) can enable IoT devices to make voice calls.
body_markdown:
Some IoT services would require the possibility to include a basic voice connection to utilize the full benefits of IoT connectivity and deliver the best user experience. One example use case is assistance communication services, for example, when it is easier to talk to a person to explain what you need help with, such as in a broken elevator or simply when the coffee machine is broken.


The technology to enable this is here now: Cat-M1 (LTE Category M1). This is a radio technology that offers benefits such as high mobility, low cost, wide coverage, flexible deployment and low latency. By adding[VoLTE](https://www.ericsson.com/en/volte) support to Cat-M1, IoT devices that have implemented this technology have the capability to make operator voice calls.


If you did not have the chance to visit Mobile World Congress in Shanghai June 2017, you can now see the VoLTE for Cat-M1[demonstration](https://youtu.be/CWFFY527muo) that we performed there together with[China Unicom and Qualcomm](https://www.ericsson.com/en/press-releases/2017/7/china-unicom-ericsson-and-qualcomm-first-to-demonstrate-cat-m1-volte-use-cases) . We have implemented the same demo at Ericsson’s headquarters in Sweden, so now you can also see it in[this video recording](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CWFFY527muo&feature=youtu.be) .


The demonstration in the video is run over Ericsson’s network in Stockholm, and it uses the latest Ericsson virtual IMS, EPC, UDM, LTE RAN and Massive IoT software. This software is available for commercial deployments now, and you can get support to deploy it with the newly launched[Massive IoT network services](https://www.ericsson.com/en/press-releases/2017/7/ericsson-launches-network-services-for-massive-iot) from Ericsson. This functionality will also continue to evolve in upcoming software releases to improve the technology and user benefits even further.


For additional reading, see:[Ericsson Mobile Telephony Evolution with VoLTE](https://www.ericsson.com/en/portfolio?nav=marketcategory001%257Cfgb_101_0071+https://www.ericsson.com/ourportfolio/networks-products/lte-radio-access-network?nav%3dfgb_101_0561%7cfgb_101_0517) and[Ericsson LTE Radio Access Network](https://www.ericsson.com/en/portfolio/networks/ericsson-radio-system/radio-system-software/lte-radio-access-network) .


Or visit us in Stockholm and try the demo live.
